body:
🌿 Welcome to cityboii SMP! 🌿

A chill and friendly Survival experience where you can build, explore, and grow without PvP.

🏡 Features:
• Pure Survival gameplay
• Friendly community
• Economy system
• Player shops
• Custom items
• Events & rewards
• Smooth & lag-free server

🌎 Build your dream base.
💰 Become the richest player.
🤝 Make friends and create your own story.

Join today and start your survival adventure!
